Exact crop of the published Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side), PDF page 16: the slip of [[Yoda, Great Warrior (Errata 3)]] (official text as of 27 April 2013; PDF built February 2014). It prints errata version PC-E3 (“Deploys only to battlegrounds. Power +3 while defending a battle. You may not deploy [Episode I] Jedi. While with a Wookiee, adds one battle destiny. Once per game, may lose 2 Force from Force Pile to cancel a non-[Immune to Sense] Interrupt. Immune to attrition.”), word for word the text of [[Yoda, Great Warrior]]. The label under the slip reads “•Yoda’s Hope (V)”, as printed in the Master List.<ref>[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Master List (Light Side)]]. Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
